description: Evidence-backed 10-dimension quality rubric for Godot 4 games generated by Bhippi Studio

dimensions.description: Game boots without crashing or fatal Godot errors
Win and lose conditions are clear and reachable
Input mapping responds smoothly and predictably
Levels, objectives, or laps can be completed
Player respawns or restarts cleanly on defeat
Zero unhandled exceptions or orphan nodes during play
Camera framing, lighting, and materials are clear
Score, health, or objective progress displays on screen
Visual style, assets, and theme match the archetype
Sustained frame rate >= 60 FPS without memory leaks

invariant: Unobserved dimensions stay not_measured and never become zero.
name: Godot 4 ADE Quality Rubric v2
